notes.title: "Cursor Kingdom" NEXT FEST DemoV1.2 Version Update Announcement
"Cursor Kingdom" NEXT FEST DemoV1.1 Update Announcement
"Cursor Kingdom" has added a free demo version to NextFest Oct 2024
notes.notes:
When the goblin army is invading your kingdom, all you have to do is drive them out! The casual tower defense game "Cursor Kingdom" has released a demo version at this year's NextFest Oct 2024. The demo version will include the game's play process, basic trial levels, and unlock regular defense towers and magic cards! You can experience the overall gameplay! You can provide us with any play suggestions here! Thank you again (^__^)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185377/e360e42400abae21c39952472bfc75de3d037939.png

Game Introduction
This is a medieval fantasy-style tower defense strategy game. Players will take on the role of the kingdom's defender, protecting the kingdom's main fortress from being destroyed by the goblin army. The only resource consumed in the game is the player's cursor operation time. Players can directly kill goblins or build and upgrade defense towers through the cursor. Reasonably constructing defense towers with different functions can make the player's defense line stronger, and with the cursor to kill enemies, it can defend against increasingly powerful goblin army attacks.

🌟 Simple operation, all operations can be completed with just the cursor, the faster the hand speed, the more efficient the resource utilization
🌟 Click operation combined with magic card elements, combined with tower defense gameplay, the combination of finger speed and strategic nature, opening the defense storm
🌟 Goblins with different characteristics form a powerful goblin army that launches attacks in waves, we can win if we hold on
As a brave warrior protecting the world, start your kingdom defense battle!

Tap to eliminate goblins and defend the kingdom
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185377/1fec3e20c4cc8ed257f92b5be154f856e9f6c945.png
Utilize the functions of various defense towers, combined with click gameplay, to establish the strongest defense line, fend off enemy attacks, and pass through a variety of game levels;

Complete levels to unlock buildings and magic cards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185377/7540079afb5e9ad658886088a93ccd0b9915d063.png
Beat the game to unlock new buildings and magic cards. You can choose to pair 5 buildings and 2 magic cards in each level, and find your own style through combinations.

Cast magic to eliminate all enemies
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185377/103b3b03a66c16814d2b78fa9fb9e3702929aa50.jpg
With the powerful abilities of various magic cards, you can provide solid protection for yourself while building the defense line!
